entities.name: Xylella fastidiosa DHQS
observations: 370-aa sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt B2I9G0 3-dehydroquinate synthase; predicted mass 39,407.9 Da and pI 6.42.
Catalyzes DAHP to 3-dehydroquinate plus phosphate (EC 4.2.3.4; Rhea RHEA:21968).
Reference annotation reports NAD+ and one divalent Co2+ or Zn2+ per subunit; cytoplasmic, chorismate biosynthesis step 2/7.
Pfam hits: DHQ_synthase (PF01761) and DHQS_C (PF24621), with Fe-ADH_2 (PF13685) also detected.
